name: Implement a multi-file stats package
instruction: Complete the stats package across two files. In stats/central.py implement mean(xs) (arithmetic mean) and median(xs) (middle value; for even length, the average of the two middle values after sorting). In stats/spread.py implement variance(xs) as the POPULATION variance (divide by N) reusing mean() from central, and stdev(xs) as its square root. Do not change the public API in stats/__init__.py.
verifyCmd: python3 -c "import stats; assert stats.mean([1,2,3,4])==2.5; assert stats.median([1,2,3,4])==2.5; assert stats.median([3,1,2])==2; assert abs(stats.variance([1,2,3,4,5])-2.0)<1e-9; assert abs(stats.stdev([1,2,3,4,5])-(2.0**0.5))<1e-9; print('ok')"
